Next.js TypeScript app in `src` (App Router); components `src/components`, hooks `src/hooks`, utilities `src/lib`, routes `src/app`, APIs `src/app/api/*`, assets `public/`, scripts `scripts/`, Vite app `vite-base-template/`.
`npm run dev`; `npm run build`; `npm run start`; `npm run lint`; `cd vite-base-template && npm run dev`; `npm --prefix vite-base-template run build`.
TypeScript strict, noEmit; `@/*` → `src/*`; ESLint `eslint.config.mjs` (<REDACTED_USER>/no-explicit-any disabled); 2 spaces; PascalCase components, camelCase variables/functions, kebab-case files. Tailwind v4.
No test runner configured. Prefer Vitest or Jest + React Testing Library; colocate `Component.test.tsx` or `__tests__/`; cover critical paths.
Imperative, concise commits; PRs include summary/rationale, local test steps, UI screenshots, linked issues, and builds/lints/local-run checklist.
Use `.env.local` for developer machines; do not commit secrets. `NEXT_PUBLIC_*` are client-exposed. Rotate any leaked credentials promptly; prefer per-env keys.
Rewrites `/iframe/*` to dynamic API `src/app/api/iframe`.
